title: Up and Down the Tree
statementMd:
You are given a [tree](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_(graph_theory)) with $n$ vertices; its root is vertex $1$. Also there is a token, initially placed in the root. You can move the token to other vertices. Let's assume current vertex of token is $v$, then you make any of the following two possible moves:

- move down to any **leaf** in subtree of $v$;
- if vertex $v$ is a leaf, then move up to the parent no more than $k$ times. In other words, if $h(v)$ is the depth of vertex $v$ (the depth of the root is $0$), then you can move to vertex $to$ such that $to$ is an ancestor of $v$ and $h(v) - k \le h(to)$.

Consider that root is not a leaf (even if its degree is $1$). Calculate the maximum number of different leaves you can visit during one sequence of moves.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $n$ and $k$ ($1 \le k \lt n \le 10^6$) — the number of vertices in the tree and the restriction on moving up, respectively.

The second line contains $n - 1$ integers $p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$, where $p_i$ is the parent of vertex $i$.

It is guaranteed that the input represents a valid tree, rooted at $1$.

## Output

Print one integer — the maximum possible number of different leaves you can visit.

## Note

The graph from the first example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/690965c5da5b23083fe4361e310e19c34f5f931b.png)

One of the optimal ways is the next one: $1 \rightarrow 2 \rightarrow 1 \rightarrow 5 \rightarrow 3 \rightarrow 7 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 6$.

The graph from the second example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bfec16e46511f911a6159f9a83bc9d268e5e0432.png)

One of the optimal ways is the next one: $1 \rightarrow 7 \rightarrow 5 \rightarrow 8$. Note that there is no way to move from $6$ to $7$ or $8$ and vice versa.
statementZhMd:
给定一棵有 $n$ 个顶点的[树](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_(graph_theory))，其根为顶点 $1$。此外，还有一个初始位于根节点的令牌。你可以将令牌移动到其他顶点。假设令牌当前位于顶点 $v$，那么你可以进行以下两种移动中的任意一种：

- 向下移动到 $v$ 的子树中的任意一个**叶节点**；
- 如果顶点 $v$ 是叶节点，则向上移动至其父节点，最多移动 $k$ 次。换句话说，若 $h(v)$ 是顶点 $v$ 的深度（根的深度为 $0$），那么你可以移动到满足以下条件的顶点 $to$：$to$ 是 $v$ 的祖先，且 $h(v) - k \le h(to)$。

求在一次移动序列中，你最多可以访问多少个不同的叶节点。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $k$（$1 \le k \lt n \le 10^6$），分别表示树的顶点数和向上移动的限制。

第二行包含 $n - 1$ 个整数 $p_2, p_3, \dots, p_n$，其中 $p_i$ 表示顶点 $i$ 的父节点。

保证输入表示一棵以 $1$ 为根的合法树。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即最多可以访问的不同叶节点数量。

## 说明

第一个样例中的图：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/690965c5da5b23083fe4361e310e19c34f5f931b.png)

一种最优移动方式如下：$1 \rightarrow 2 \rightarrow 1 \rightarrow 5 \rightarrow 3 \rightarrow 7 \rightarrow 4 \rightarrow 6$。

第二个样例中的图：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bfec16e46511f911a6159f9a83bc9d268e5e0432.png)

一种最优移动方式如下：$1 \rightarrow 7 \rightarrow 5 \rightarrow 8$。注意，无法从 $6$ 移动到 $7$ 或 $8$，反之亦然。
